description: This file defines the registry and capabilities for node commands in the OpenClaw Android application, including command specifications, available capabilities based on runtime flags, and command lookup functionality.

classes.name: NodeRuntimeFlags
classes.description: Data class representing the runtime state flags for various device capabilities.

classes.name: InvokeCommandAvailability
classes.description: Enum defining when certain commands are available based on device capabilities or build configurations.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityAvailability
classes.description: Enum specifying the availability conditions for node capabilities.

classes.name: NodeCapabilitySpec
classes.description: Data class specifying a capability's name and when it is available.

classes.name: InvokeCommandSpec
classes.description: Data class defining a command's name, whether it requires foreground execution, and its availability conditions.

classes.name: InvokeCommandRegistry
classes.description: Object that maintains the registry of command specifications, capability manifest, and functions for lookup and filtering commands based on runtime flags.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieves command specification by its name.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a list of capability names supported based on current runtime flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands
methods.description: Returns a list of command names that are available based on current runtime flags.
